description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminQueue page in an online examination system. It handles page load logic related to course queue management by interacting with a database, as well as navigation controls for the admin interface. The code manages session data, performs database queries to check course queue status, and handles events triggered by button clicks and grid view selection.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: The code-behind class for the AdminQueue ASP.NET page, managing course queue operations and navigation actions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load; manages session validation, checks course queue status, and potentially deletes entries from the queue.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the admin panel from the home button.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation back to the AdminQueue page from a profile button.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles logout action and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of a grid view row, storing selected student and course IDs in session variables, and navigating to the ShowAns page.
